p1: Nehemiah worked for a great king far away. His job was to bring the king his wine.
One day, Nehemiah’s face looked sad. The king asked, “Why is your face so sad?” Nehemiah felt very afraid.
Nehemiah said, “Jerusalem, my family’s city, is broken. Its gates were burned.” Its strong walls, which kept the people safe, were broken down too.
p2: The king asked, “What do you want?” First, Nehemiah prayed to Heavenly Father. Then he said, “Please send me to build it again.” The king said yes! He gave Nehemiah letters and wood to help.
Heavenly Father hears you anytime, even when you pray in your heart. Tonight, tell Him one thing you need help with.
old: Far away in the king’s palace, a man named Nehemiah heard sad news. The walls around Jerusalem were broken down, and his people were not safe.
Nehemiah’s heart felt so heavy. But he knew just what to do — he prayed and prayed to Heavenly Father for many days.
Then Nehemiah felt brave. He asked the king, “May I please go home and rebuild the walls?” And the king said yes! He even sent wood to help.

When Nehemiah reached Jerusalem, he quietly rode all around the broken walls at night to see what needed fixing. Then he told the people, “Come, let us rise up and build!” Heavenly Father had turned his heavy heart into a brave one.
